description: Aseprite v1.2.15 English UI — self-drawn Allegro UI, no UIA. Adapter drives it via screenshot OCR of the top menu strip and keyboard hotkeys. Drawing/canvas actions are intentionally not exposed here yet.

actions.description: Press an arbitrary Aseprite hotkey combination (Ctrl+Z undo, Ctrl+S save, etc.). No screenshot verification; caller decides how to observe result.

Select a tool via its stock v1.2.15 hotkey. Supported: pencil, spray, eraser, paintBucket, line, rectangle, ellipse, text, magicWand, hand, eyedropper, move, rectangularMarquee. If the user rebound hotkeys inside Aseprite this returns success but selects the wrong tool.
Set canvas zoom to a discrete preset via its stock hotkey. Supported: 100, 200, 400, 800, 1600, 3200 (percent).

Capture the top menu strip, OCR it, then click the labeled entry. Supported names: File, Edit, Sprite, Layer, Frame, Select, Tags, View, Help. Requires DP_WITH_OCR=ON. Returns the recognized OCR score and clicked window-relative point.
